s: The BYU Family History Technology Lab is a non-profit student research lab sponsored by BYU's computer science department. We work with FamilySearch to help provide innovative and exciting ways to explore your family history.

September 15, 2025 - The BYU Family History Library (FHL) is located in the Harold B. Lee Library (HBLL) on the campus of Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah. It is one of the Family History Centers devoted to assisting library patrons in genealogical research.
